Har group chat me ek invisible newspaper chalta hai. Koi local food correspondent hota hai, koi breaking-news desk, aur koi person jo sirf "arre suno" likh kar story shuru karta hai.

Chhota blog bhi wahi hai: duniya par report karne ka license, bas scale kam hai aur tone tumhari hai.

Apna tiny newspaper banao. Teen sections rakho: **Dekha** (ek scene), **Suna** (ek line ya awaaz), aur **Socha** (uske baad kya atka). Har section 50 words ka. Finish karna flawless hone se zyada important hai.

Pehla issue [[Chai ki aakhri chuski]] se nikle, ya [[Sheher ko paidal padhna]] ke baad ki walk se. Regular hona pressure nahi hona chahiye—bas apni awaaz ko thodi jagah do.
